items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I hugged him and kissed him, and Cozy Cole, and Shavern, and all of us went to the bard and had a drink together.

ctx.x: You were traveling in the South then?

I was traveling in the South with Cab Calloway‟s band, Cozy Cole, and she was there with me around about that time. I was playing a solo and Benny [Unintelligible} the piano player said to me, he said, “I heard your father‟s in town, did you see him”? I said, “No”. He said, “Well there he is standing over there in the wings”. I saw this guy standing over there looking exactly like me [laugh]. I didn‟t know what to say to him. He had contributed nothing towards my education and my well-being, and my mother had to…
